name: Ráquira: capital artesanal de la alfarería
description: Boyacá town known as Colombia's craft capital, where pottery is the main craft. Artesanías de Colombia's 2026 coverage notes a protected denomination of origin for Ráquira artisan ceramics and JICA-backed technical assistance workshops for local artisans.
descriptionOriginal: Artesanos de Ráquira ahora con Denominación de Origen: la SIC protegió la «Cerámica Artesanal de Ráquira Colombia».
details: Artesanías de Colombia also runs a clay-to-object feature series on Ráquira techniques ('de arcilla a objeto artesanal'). Many shops let visitors try the wheel (travel press, not verified individually). No published rules on clay collecting found; clay is worked locally (Ráquira red clay, see Santiago Rodríguez Ruiz entry).

name: Fiestas Patronales de Ráquira: Concurso de Torneros
nameEnglish: Ráquira Patron Festival: potters' wheel contest
description: Annual town festival (12 to 15 June 2026) whose programme included a Concurso de Torneros, a cultural contest on the wheel-throwing process behind Ráquira's pottery, on Monday 15 June at 2 pm.
descriptionOriginal: Concurso de Torneros, competencia cultural el proceso de las artesanías.
details: Venue for the contest not named on the page. Dates for the 2027 edition not yet known.

name: Taller de artesanía en Ráquira
description: Three-hour guided pottery workshop in Ráquira where a craftsperson teaches you to design and make your own clay piece; guides speak Spanish and English.
descriptionOriginal: Un experto artesano guía a los participantes para diseñar y elaborar su propia pieza de barro.
details: Booking-platform listing (from 56 EUR). Operator not named and no dates shown; meeting point listed as a hotel in Villa de Leyva. Confirm before travelling.

name: Santiago Rodríguez Ruiz (escultor raquireño)
description: Ráquira-born sculptor whose 2026 installation ABA used about 200 hand-modelled pieces of Ráquira red clay, dried, fired and polished, decorated with engobes and sgraffito. Shown at UN_FAIR Tequendama, Bogotá, 18 to 27 September 2026.
descriptionOriginal: Piezas de «arcilla roja de Ráquira»; las superficies usan «engobes y esgrafiados».
details: Evidence of a working contemporary artist using local clay; no information found on teaching or hosting, so contact only as an inspiration/networking lead.

name: Cerámica Negra de La Chamba
description: Riverside veredas (La Chamba and Chipuelo Oriente) with 300+ years of black and red pottery, protected since December 2019 as the Denominación de Origen 'Cerámica Negra de La Chamba'. Pieces are made from three local clays, finished with a slip varnish and smoked ('negreado').
descriptionOriginal: Se combinan tres arcillas de la zona: la lisa (plasticidad), la arenosa (secado uniforme) y la roja (negreado).
details: Use of the denomination is authorised through the SIC, delegated to the artisan association ASOARCH (Asociación de Artesanos de las Veredas La Chamba y Chipuelo). Products covered: domestic and culinary ware.

name: Predio de arcilla negra de La Chamba
nameEnglish: La Chamba black-clay pit (community clay plot)
description: Clay plot owned by the Tolima departmental government with about 1.79 ha suitable for extraction; in 2023 artisans reported having no legal access and digging by hand in open pits about 0.5 m deep on private rice and corn land, while an ordinance to recover the plot for community use was pursued.
descriptionOriginal: Los artesanos están «obligados a ingresar a predios privados» para extraer arcilla; se busca recuperar el predio de la Gobernación del Tolima.
details: Key customs and rules for wild clay: manual extraction, three clays blended, access governed by landowner/Gobernación. A 2025 thesis cites the 2023 initiative as a model for formalising artisanal clay mining. Current legal status of access not confirmed; ask ASOARCH before collecting.

name: Taller Escuela Manos de Oro (La Chamba)
nameEnglish: Manos de Oro workshop-school, La Chamba
description: Workshop-school in the vereda La Chamba run by local artisans where visitors can watch and take part in black-clay work from clay extraction through modelling and firing.
descriptionOriginal: Visitantes pueden participar «desde la extracción del barro hasta el moldeado y cocción de las piezas».
details: Documented by Canal Trece's 'Rezeteando' in August 2024; no booking details found. Products: tableware, pots, decorative and pre-Columbian-style pieces, nativity figures.

image.alt: Taller Escuela Manos de Oro (La Chamba)

name: Cerámica de El Carmen de Viboral
nameEnglish: El Carmen de Viboral hand-painted ceramics
description: Antioquia pottery town famed for hand-painted underglaze tableware, inscribed in 2024 on Colombia's national intangible heritage list. In September 2026 about 11 workshops and 12 decorators produced a new collection; visitors can tour workshops and paint their own piece.
descriptionOriginal: Visitantes pueden recorrer talleres, conocer el proceso y pintar su pieza; «conozca a quienes mantienen vivo este oficio».
details: Associated with white kaolin clay (secondary source, not opened). Plan Especial de Salvaguardia published by the Ministerio de Cultura. Contact via the town's tourism office (@turismoelcarmendeviboral).

image.alt: Cerámica de El Carmen de Viboral

name: Fiesta de los Saberes Cerámicos Patrimoniales
description: 2026 festival of El Carmen de Viboral's ceramic tradition at which the collection 'Jardín en casa: la taza de nuestra tierra' (hand-painted coffee cups) was launched.
descriptionOriginal: Propuesta presentada durante la Fiesta de los Saberes Cerámicos Patrimoniales 2026 con 12 decoradores y 11 talleres.
details: Article dated 27 September 2026; exact festival dates not stated. The earlier 'Fiestas de la Loza' (December 2020 edition seen) is a related town celebration.

name: Cerámica artesanal de Pitalito (laboyana)
description: Huila pottery centre known for the clay 'chiva'. A 2025 master's thesis surveyed 69 artisans: over 80% are in low socioeconomic strata and struggle to access quality clay.
descriptionOriginal: Dificultades para acceder a arcilla de calidad; «la extracción en Pitalito se realiza sin una planificación técnica».
details: Thesis (Universidad de Manizales, 2025) says identified clay deposits lack environmental management plans or legal recognition by mining authorities, so collecting rules are unsettled; treat any clay access as informal and ask local associations first.

name: Yacimientos de arcilla de Pitalito
description: Clay deposits used by Pitalito potters, currently extracted without technical planning or recognised management plans; the thesis proposes tying artisans to formal, community-based mining.
descriptionOriginal: Los yacimientos identificados no cuentan aún con planes de manejo ambiental ni esquemas de legalidad reconocidos.
details: Useful context on wild-clay customs and legality; exact pit locations not published. Recommended practice cited: sieving and ageing clay 3 to 6 months, separating by veins (Ministerio de Ambiente / Minas guide, 2021).

name: Taller de chivas de arcilla (Manos de Alfareros / COARPI)
description: Five-hour guided visit combining a clay factory (Manos de Alfareros), the artisan cooperative COARPI and a hands-on session shaping and painting your own chiva.
descriptionOriginal: Visita a la fábrica de arcilla Manos de Alfareros y a COARPI; el visitante moldea y pinta su propia chiva.
details: Sold via Civitatis (from about US$124, English-speaking guide). Operator not named; availability live on the page.

name: Cooperativa de Artesanos de Pitalito (COARPI)
description: Artisan cooperative of Pitalito that explains the history and production of the Chiva de Pitalito, a product with a Huila designation of origin.
descriptionOriginal: COARPI: la historia, el concepto y el proceso de producción de la Chiva de Pitalito.
details: Visited as part of the tour above; no standalone website found.

name: Feria Nacional Artesanal de Pitalito
description: Long-running national craft fair held each November at the Cámara de Comercio in the Valle de Laboyos; edition 58 ran 8 to 12 November 2024.
descriptionOriginal: Pitalito, Huila celebra la versión 58 de la Feria Nacional Artesanal (8 al 12 de noviembre).
details: Latest dates confirmed are 2024; 2026 edition dates not confirmed (an edition 60 would be expected). Hours then: 9 am to 9 pm.

name: Taller de cerámica técnica guane (Barichara)
description: Two-hour ceramics workshop learning the Guane technique used by Indigenous peoples of the Barichara area: tools, clay preparation and shaping a piece.
descriptionOriginal: El taller comienza con la «técnica guane», usada por los pueblos indígenas que vivieron en Barichara.
details: Civitatis listing (about 3 hours incl. transfer, from US$33). You receive a pre-made piece because yours needs a day to dry. Operator not named.

name: Casa Taller El Boga
description: Artist residency in a 17th-century house in Mompox's heritage centre. Stays 1 to 4 weeks or 1 to 3 months, applications open year-round; ties residents to local artisans and knowledge-holders.
descriptionOriginal: Residencia en Mompox con encuentros y talleres con artesanos y sabedores locales.
details: One month costs COP 3,100,000 (Colombians) or EUR 890 (international), with private room. No clay or kiln facilities mentioned on the listing; ask whether ceramics work is possible. Website: elbogamompox.com.

name: Mompox Summer 2026 (Universidad del Rosario): foco cerámica y alfarería
description: Universidad del Rosario summer programme in Mompox whose schedule opens with a pottery (alfarería) focus: virtual seminars and in-person ceramics workshops from 1 to 8 June 2026, daily workshops and two ceramic firings later in the programme.
descriptionOriginal: Cerámica: Alfarería. Introducción a los materiales y técnicas. Taller de cerámica. QUEMA CERÁMICA.
details: Schedule PDF dated April 2026; the 2026 edition has ended, so check urosario.edu.co for a 2027 call. Eligibility and fees not stated in the schedule.

name: ArteSumapaz
description: Self-directed month-long residency near San Bernardo (Sumapaz) for visual artists, clay artists, writers and others, on a campus of about 230 acres with home-stay housing, meals and weekly open critiques.
descriptionOriginal: Residencia autodirigida con acceso a estudios en un campus con parque natural.
details: 2026 edition ran 1 to 31 May (fee about USD 975, unfunded). Listing mentions a 'ceramic facility' but not a kiln; confirm kiln and next call with the organiser. Information comes from an aggregator listing, not the organiser's own site.

name: Cerámica por el agua (Fuego Refugio, Patialegre, La Cabuya)
nameEnglish: Ceramics for water project, Los Santos
description: Project by the Fuego Refugio and Patialegre ceramic workshops and the La Cabuya foundation that revives the local ceramic trade in Los Santos, Santander: clay water filters, a community-built kiln and a new training group (semillero).
descriptionOriginal: Creación de filtros de agua en arcilla; se construyó un horno cerámico comunitario.
details: Funded by a Ministerio de Cultura artistic-training grant; reported 13 November 2024. Source of clay not stated. Good contact for community kiln-building and local clay practice.

image.alt: Cerámica por el agua (Fuego Refugio, Patialegre, La Cabuya)
image.credit: Image: Radio Televisión Nacional de Colombia

name: Mundo de la Forma y la Voz de la Materia
nameEnglish: World of Form and the Voice of Matter (Nariño women potters)
description: Collective of twelve women potters in Pasto and Nariño, coordinated by Ana Tumal, combining technologists and licensed ceramists and linking their work to Pastos, Abades and Quillasinga ceramic heritage.
descriptionOriginal: Un encuentro de saberes y profesiones: mujeres nariñenses que esculpen la historia con el barro.
details: Article dated 22 November 2023; current activity not confirmed. Clay source not stated.

image.alt: Mundo de la Forma y la Voz de la Materia
image.credit: Image: Radio Televisión Nacional de Colombia

name: Daniel Felipe Hurtado Sánchez (Sibundoy)
nameEnglish: Daniel Hurtado, potter and teacher, Sibundoy
description: Young Sibundoy potter (geology student) teaching ancestral hand-building techniques (pinch, coil, slab) with Kamëntsá collaborators to keep Putumayo's nearly extinct ceramic tradition alive; clay is gathered and cleaned by hand.
descriptionOriginal: La tradición se ha ido perdiendo; talleres de pellizco, enrollado y plancha con arcilla recogida a mano.
details: Source is a June 2022 Radio Nacional piece; current activity unconfirmed. A museum in Sibundoy's public library holds Pastos/Quillacinga funerary urns.

image.credit: Image: Radio Televisión Nacional de Colombia

name: Magma Cerámica
description: Ceramics school and workshop in La Candelaria, Bogotá, with a Fundamentos de la Cerámica course; Artesanías de Colombia has also promoted a workshop with the master potter Rosa María Jerez and her exhibition 'Cien Vírgenes' (14 to 28 May).
descriptionOriginal: La Escuela Magma Cerámica tiene abiertas las inscripciones para sus cursos de cerámica en Bogotá.
details: Revista Diners (Sept 2024) gave Calle 12B #2-55, one-hour group classes (about COP 50,000) with firing included. Year of the Jerez workshop/exhibition not stated on the page (listing updated Oct 2026).

name: Primitivo Studio Pottery
description: Bogotá studio offering a ceramics training programme, glaze masterclass, hand-shaping experiences, coworking space and firing service, and selling engobes, glazes and clays.
descriptionOriginal: Un lugar para crear, aprender, experimentar y descubrir todo lo que puede pasar alrededor de la cerámica.
details: Address given as Calle 122 #45-40. Site shows 2026 copyright and content. Good option for glaze work and kiln access.

name: Ceramyst
description: Bogotá supplier and design lab for clay: glazes, equipment and a corporate clay workshop, plus additive-manufacturing and parametric-design training; catalogue via WhatsApp.
descriptionOriginal: Taller de Arcilla Corporativo; CERAMYST LAB; hornos y esmaltes bajo cotización.
details: Address Cra 52B #118-63 on the site (geocoding unreliable, shown at city centre). Site shows no dated content later than 2023, so current activity should be confirmed by message.

name: Sirena Azuleja Cerámica
nameEnglish: Sirena Azuleja ceramics (glaze supplies and advice)
description: Colombian online shop selling base glazes, powdered engobes (1100 to 1220 C) and pyrometric cones, with glaze formulation advice, an online glaze course and in-person workshops listed for 2026.
descriptionOriginal: Soporte acerca de formulación de esmaltes, engobes, curvas de quema y conos pirométricos.
details: Very relevant for learning glaze chemistry. Page gives no street address (a supplier directory lists it in Bogotá, not independently confirmed); shown at city centre.

name: Cerámica: mirando hacia adentro (Universidad Nacional, Educación Continuada)
description: In-person Saturday ceramics workshop at Universidad Nacional de Colombia's continuing education centre on pre-Columbian ceramic legacy, with hands-on making and a look at Colombia's traditional ceramic groups.
descriptionOriginal: Taller sobre el legado de las culturas precolombinas; sábados de 9:00 a 13:00.
details: Aprendemas listing without dates, price or instructor; request info from the centre. UNAL's Escuela de Artes Plásticas also has a ceramics studio (secondary sources).

name: Cerámica (Universidad del Rosario, Decanatura del Medio Universitario)
description: University ceramics workshop covering history of art and ceramics, clay properties, hand-building, textures, glazes and oxides, with museum visits and a final exhibition.
descriptionOriginal: Propiedades de la arcilla, modelado a mano, esmaltes y óxidos; exposición final.
details: Aprendemas listing; duration, price and dates not listed. Confirm with the Decanatura.

name: Opción en Cerámica (Universidad de los Andes)
nameEnglish: Ceramics option, Universidad de los Andes
description: 16-credit ceramics option for Universidad de los Andes undergraduates: clay properties, basic techniques, glaze and engobe formulation, throwing as a tool for spatial exploration, moulding and assembly.
descriptionOriginal: La opción en Cerámica ofrece cursos para aprender técnicas cerámicas… Se experimenta con técnicas de moldeado, ensamblado, esmaltes y engobes.
details: Only for Uniandes undergraduate students; offered subject to semester availability.

name: Curso de cerámica para jóvenes y adultos (Universidad Distrital, ASAB)
nameEnglish: Ceramics course for youth and adults (ASAB)
description: In-person ceramics course for young people and adults offered through the Facultad de Artes ASAB of Universidad Distrital Francisco José de Caldas.
descriptionOriginal: Curso de cerámica para jóvenes y adultos del centro.
details: Aprendemas listing with empty syllabus, price and dates; confirm with the faculty.

name: Museo Arqueológico Casa del Marqués de San Jorge (MUSA)
nameEnglish: Archaeological Museum, Marqués de San Jorge House
description: La Candelaria museum with pre-Columbian ceramics. Its 2026 exhibition 'Arqueología de la Infancia' (19 June to 15 August) showed rattles, vessels and ceramic stamps; a booked tour pairs a museum visit with a pre-Hispanic-style ceramics workshop.
descriptionOriginal: Sonajeros, vasijas, sellos cerámicos y otros objetos de uso cotidiano.
details: Address Carrera 6 #7-43 (shown at neighbourhood centre). Workshop is sold on Civitatis (about US$85, 4 hours, reviews Oct 2025 and Jan 2026); local operator not named.

name: Expoartesanías 2026
description: Colombia's major annual craft fair run by Artesanías de Colombia and Corferias, scheduled for 7 to 20 December 2026 at Corferias, Bogotá; categories include contemporary tableware.
descriptionOriginal: Del 7 al 20 de diciembre de 2026, Corferias Bogotá.
details: Site does not name ceramics explicitly (categories include 'Vajillas'); useful for meeting potters and buying from communities such as Ráquira, La Chamba and El Carmen.

name: Expoartesano: La Memoria 2026
description: 17th Expoartesano craft fair held 10 to 19 July 2026 at Plaza Mayor Medellín with more than 600 artisans from all 32 Colombian departments.
descriptionOriginal: Del 10 al 19 de julio, Plaza Mayor reunirá a más de 600 artesanos del país.
details: Official city notice does not mention ceramics specifically. 2026 edition has ended; typically held each July.

name: Dos Golondrinas Estudio
description: Pottery studio in Envigado (Medellín area) making work in black and red clay with botanical-print and gradient glazes, and offering pottery classes for adults and children.
descriptionOriginal: Taller de cerámica en Medellín; clases de alfarería.
details: Address Carrera 27 DA #34 DD Sur-71, Envigado; hours Mon-Fri 9-18. Site shows 2025 copyright; class details are only available by contacting the studio.

name: Casa Terracota
description: Large house built entirely of clay and fired clay by architect and ceramist Octavio Mendoza Morales near Villa de Leyva, visitable with guided tours and talks on clay building.
descriptionOriginal: Una obra arquitectónica única; «convirtiendo la tierra cocida en arquitectura».
details: Tourism board says clay-working workshops exist but gives no format or prices. Site has ticket and rates pages; welcome post dated July 2026.
